notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal noncombat damage to a creature an opponent controls.
description:
Attempt to deal noncombat damage to a creature an opponent controls, instead putting that many -1/-1 counters on it due to Everlasting Torment.
All Will Be One triggers, putting that many -1/-1 counters on a creature an opponent controls.
Repeat step 2.
